actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (strong RNA pathway dysregulation, PBRM1 mutation enrichment, CDKN2A/chr9p loss) and no significant technical confounding. Cross-modal cohesion is weak with narrow boundaries, so structure is uncertain, but no positive structural evidence supports a split or merge and no available request could resolve this within budget; retain for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent PBRM1-mutant, BAP1-wildtype, chr3p-loss profile with no significant site confounding. Cross-modal cohesion is modest with low resampling stability and narrow boundaries, leaving structure uncertain, but no positive structural evidence indicates a defensible split or merge; retain for downstream validation.

C0003 has a strong, coherent BAP1-mutant interferon-high identity with relatively stable internal structure and no significant technical confounding. Boundaries to neighboring sets remain narrow, so structure is uncertain, but no positive structural evidence supports revision; retain for downstream validation.

C0004 has a coherent, highly significant WXS-driven identity (universal VHL mutation, complete PBRM1 absence) with large WXS boundary separations and no technical confounding. Cohesion is essentially single-modality, so structure is uncertain, but no positive structural evidence supports a split or merge; retain for downstream validation.

C0005 shows a coherent VHL/PBRM1-wildtype-enriched identity with large WXS boundary separation from C0004 and no significant technical confounding. Cross-modal support is weak (median one modality, three unsupported patients), so structure is uncertain, but no positive structural evidence indicates a defensible revision; retain for downstream validation.
